title: KRIVIO AI
technologies: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Supabase Auth, Gemini, Tailwind CSS
description: An AI-assisted business mentor and commerce toolkit for rural Indian artisans, farmers, and self-help groups. KRIVIO combines multilingual voice guidance, an AI image studio, product catalog creation, marketplace-ready exports, wholesale PDF quotations, and shareable storefronts. Built with a React and TypeScript frontend, an Express gateway, Python/FastAPI services, PostgreSQL, and Gemini integrations.

title: GitaPath
technologies: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Gemini, Supabase, Tailwind CSS, Vite
description: A source-grounded Bhagavad Gita guidance platform that connects everyday questions with relevant teachings and chapter-and-verse references. It includes structured AI conversations, a chapter browser, guided learning, reflection journaling, and voice input. The React and TypeScript interface connects to an Express API with Gemini integration and Supabase authentication.

title: TRUVA
technologies: React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, Gemini, RapidOCR, Supabase Auth, Tailwind CSS, Capacitor
description: A package-label scanning and review application with separate consumer and inspector workspaces. TRUVA extracts printed declarations, explains food-label evidence, compares compatible saved products, and presents inspection records for human review. Built with React and TypeScript, a Python/FastAPI inspection API, Gemini vision, RapidOCR, and Supabase Auth. Scan history is stored locally per account; automated findings support review rather than certify compliance.
